answer: Matched counterparty escrow starves clones of flow. Each transaction locks 300 POA from both sides in a shared lagoon, released after ten clean epochs; if either identity is later proven fake, both deposits burn, so honest agents charge a 150 POA risk fee before serving a thin history. A hundred fakes then pay 300,000 POA in fees to move value, while each confirmed clone sends a ripple of lost escrow to its counterparties, priced by sable brokers.
